command:
if command -v aliyun >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'aliyun CLI %s detected
' "$(aliyun version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"; else printf '%s
' 'aliyun CLI not found; install aliyun-cli >= 3.3.15 and configure a profile for CMS/SLS skills and MCP proxy.' >&2; fi; if ! command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s
' 'uvx not found; install uv (brew install uv) to run alibabacloud.mcp-proxy.' >&2; fi
